result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a localization/translation key is displayed as visible text instead of being replaced with actual content.

issues.description: The text 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed as a section heading instead of being translated or replaced with actual content. This appears to be an internal localization key that failed to resolve.
issues.suggestion: Replace the localization key with the properly translated section title (e.g., 'Popular Restaurants', 'Featured', etc.). Verify the localization system is properly configured to resolve all keys before rendering.
